result: In `scripts/player.gd`, `take_damage` now calls a new `_flash()` that tweens the Sprite2D's `modulate` to red and back to white, 0.1s each way (0.2s total). It kills any running flash first. I also changed the `flash_color` default from white to red, because white would have shown no flash. I haven't run it, since Godot isn't installed here.
